newsitem.title: UK: UPS raises rates, launches new services.
newsitem.headline: UPS raises rates, launches new services.

text.p: United Parcel Service is introducing several new services in the U.S. from February one and is raising some rates effective Feb one, UPS said in a statement received here.
The new services being offered in the U.S. include a noon guarantee on two-day shipments and a three pm guarantee on next-day deliveries.
"These new and enhanced services allow shippers to fyurther customize their package distribution needs," UPS senior vice president for marketing Joe Pyne said in the statement.

Amongst rate changes those for UPS Next Day Air, UPS 2nd Day Air and UPS 3-Day Select within the U.S. and Puerto rica will increase by some 3.9 percent for all commercial and residential services. Standard ground commercial shipments will increase by an average 3.4 percent and standard ground residential shipments by an average 4.3 percent.

Rates for international shipments originating in the U.S. will increae 2.8 percent for UPS Worldwide Express and 4.9 percent fopr UPS Worldwide Expedited. Rates to Canada will remain unchanged as will those for shipments originating outside the U.S.
